description: Find open reading frames (ATG…stop) across all six frames.

circular.description: Treat the molecule as a circle (plasmid), so an ORF whose stop codon lies past the origin is found. Such an ORF is reported with start > end — the wrap convention used everywhere else here. Off by default: a bare sequence or a FASTA record says nothing about topology, and a PCR product read as a circle invents a gene across a seam the tube does not have.

limit.description: How many ORFs to return, longest first. `count` always reports every ORF found and `truncated` says whether the list was cut.

requireStop.description: Only report ORFs terminated by a stop codon.

sequence.description: Nucleotide sequence (raw or FASTA; IUPAC accepted).

name: find_orfs
